title: poa arctica subsp. grayana
intro: Poa arctica subsp. grayana, commonly known as Arctic bluegrass, is a subspecies of the Poa arctica species, a type of grass native to Arctic regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help to alleviate conditions such as arthritis and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Arctic bluegrass include its ability to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and irritation, and its potential to act as an anti-microbial agent, preventing the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Arctic bluegrass include various flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
